result.summary: The street environment is dominated by vehicular traffic and embedded streetcar tracks, with no visible marked pedestrian crossings or signals. A large delivery truck parked on the right side creates a significant visual obstruction for both pedestrians and drivers, increasing the risk of mid-block crossing conflicts.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large delivery truck is parked on the right side of the road, completely blocking sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded metal tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians or cause slipping, especially in wet conditions.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked areas for pedestrians to cross this multi-lane roadway safely.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalks at regular intervals to provide designated crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight past parked vehicles.

interventions.title: Designated Loading Zones
interventions.description: Establish clear, designated loading zones away from potential crossing points to prevent large vehicles from obstructing sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and overhead traffic signals. A large commercial truck is parked or stopped in the foreground, creating a significant visual obstruction that hides the pedestrian crossing area from approaching traffic.

hazards.name: Major Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large delivery truck is positioned such that it completely blocks the line of sight between pedestrians at the curb and drivers approaching the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground and center of the frame

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the intersection to ensure that large vehicles cannot park close to the crosswalk, maintaining clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to reduce crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to motorists.

result.summary: The environment provides basic pedestrian infrastructure with sidewalks on both sides, but lacks critical safety features at the signalized intersection. There are no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, and the presence of trolley tracks in the roadway adds a physical hazard for those crossing.

hazards.name: Trolley tracks
hazards.description: Exposed metal tracks in the roadway can cause slips or trips for pedestrians and catch bicycle tires.
hazards.location_in_image: Running down the center of the street

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks any painted crosswalks for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint zebra or ladder style crosswalks to clearly delineate pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light poles.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the corners to ensure accessibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is poorly defined, lacking marked crosswalks, signals, or adequate separation from the roadway. The presence of trolley tracks and wide driveway openings creates additional hazards for those walking in the area.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway present a significant tripping hazard and can be slippery for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Running through the center of the roadway foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: The absence of painted crosswalks increases the risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflicts as there is no designated safe crossing point.

hazards.name: Wide Uncontrolled Access Point
hazards.description: The large paved lot on the left creates a wide area where vehicles may enter or exit unpredictably across the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image where the red car is parked

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly delineate pedestrian crossing areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lower-height lighting fixtures to better illuminate the sidewalk and crossing areas at night.
